name: 13b-convert-cohere-messages
description: convertCohereMessages (prompt-converters.js:384-422), two things at once. (1) The tool-call branch at :394-401: a tool-call message whose PREVIOUS turn is an assistant takes that assistant's content as its own primer and the previous turn is spliced out -- while `forEach` is iterating, so the CURRENT message shifts into the slot just vacated and the next iteration revisits it. That revisit is observable and deliberate: the function returns the same array it mutated, so `returned.chatHistory` and `mutated[0]` are the same list, and the double visit appends the primer content TWICE (once for the original index, once for the index the splice shifted it to). A port that snapshots the array before iterating visits each message exactly once and diverges on that content string. (2) The name rules at :403-418: example_assistant/example_user get their name prefix and then lose `name`, and any other named non-system turn gets the 'name: ' prefix -- but a named USER turn only loses its name, because the prefix rule at :414 requires role !== 'system' while the sibling converters additionally require a non-user role. (3) The return shape is an object, `{chatHistory: messages}`, so `returned` and `mutated` both carry the array.
